executable_template.applicability_check: Use an executable candidate with an unchanged stat fingerprint, make subprocess.run raise TimeoutExpired or OSError twice inside the cache TTL, and confirm whether both calls launch the dependency probe.
executable_template.patch_strategy: Convert caught probe exceptions into the same false result used for a normal non-zero probe, then let the existing fingerprint-bound, TTL-bound, size-bounded cache store and reuse that negative result.
executable_template.rollback_plan: Revert the exception-result fallthrough and its regression together; if negative caching proves too broad, keep the bounded cache for normal return codes and add a shorter dedicated exception TTL instead of restoring repeated 10-second probes.
